summary: A Yes vote enacts a City of Needles transient occupancy (hotel) tax on lodging stays.

tax.text: Measure K would phase in an increase in Needles' transient occupancy tax from 10% to 14% to raise revenue for general city services.
tax.quote: by increasing the City of Needles Transient Occupancy Tax paid primarily by hotel, motel, and short-term rental guests from 10% to 14% in phases

tax.text: A No vote opposes raising Needles’ transient occupancy tax from 10% to 14% to generate revenue for general city services.
tax.quote: Shall the measure to maintain and improve quality of life by supporting local businesses and jobs; keeping public areas safe, clean, and well maintained; maintaining and improving streets, parks, and other public infrastructure; and funding other general City services, by increasing the City of Needles Transient Occupancy Tax paid primarily by hotel, motel, and short-term rental guests from 10% to 14% in phases, generating approximately $400,000 annually, with annual public disclosure and remaining effective until ended by voters, be adopted?
